content: KMC3 (Kokot, Dlugosz, Deorowicz, Bioinformatics 2017;33:2759) two-stage design: (1) partition reads into hundreds of disk bins by signatures - canonical m-mer minimizers excluding AAA/ACA prefixes and internal AA; (2) per-bin RADULS radix sort + duplicate counting. Super-kmers = maximal runs of consecutive k-mers sharing a minimizer, stored as one substring per bin. KMC3 over KMC2: faster gzipped FASTQ I/O, improved signature-to-bin assignment, RADULS replaces plain radix sort. Reference architecture for rustkmer v2.0 partitioned counting; stages map onto existing rayon chunk loop + streaming_merge external-sort machinery.
